pageCache.text:
Be who God meant you to be...
Welcome to our new website
We are a Federation of two schools united by this shared mission, which underpins all that we do at both The Annunciation Catholic Infant School and The Annunciation Catholic Junior School. As a Federation, both schools strive to enrich the academic, cultural and spiritual lives of our pupils, supporting the children in truly flourishing into who God meant them to be.
Founded by Dominican Sisters, since their inception the Schools have been dedicated to nurturing the children and community we serve. As a Federation of Catholic Schools, we recognise our unique responsibility to work in partnership with our families and parish to celebrate and embolden our faith in the community and our young people. Our entire staff and Governors fully understand and embrace this responsibility and are dedicated to carrying on the work and legacy of our founders.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Federation of The Annunciation Catholic Schools - Catholic Life And Mission
pageCache.text:
Catholic Life And Mission
‘Be who God meant you to be, and you will set the world on fire.’
At The Federation of The Annunciation Catholic Schools, our school mission statement is the foundation of the Catholic Life and lived mission of the school. We endeavour to instil in our pupils that our faith calls us to love God and to love our neighbours in every situation, especially our sisters and brothers living in poverty or other challenging situations. Following in the footsteps of Christ, we hope to make present in our unjust and broken world, the justice, love and peace of God. It is by doing so that we truly become who God meant us to be and in turn spread the flame of his love through the world.
We nurture this understanding through our collective worship, assemblies and prayer which help our pupils understand the centrality of our faith to our daily lives. We also develop an understanding of the duty we are called to undertake as Catholics to spread God’s love through our actions. We have worked to embed the principles of Catholic Social Teaching through our curriculum. We also provide opportunities for the pupils serve their community and lead on action through selecting and raising money for charities allowing them to live in service of the calling of our faith and be who God meant them to be.

pageCache.text:
Mission Statement and Values
‘Be who God meant you to be and you will set the world on fire.’
Our mission statement “Be who God meant you to be, and you will set the world on fire” and was created with pupils, parents, staff and governors. We believe it underpins everything we do at our schools. All of the adults and pupils at The Annnunciation Catholic Schools, strive each day, to ensure we are safe, happy and excited to learn with the belief that we can achieve anything. With God’s guidance and blessing, we walk alongside our one another, as we undertake our faith and educational journeys.
Respect - Tolerance – Commitment – Safety – Excellence – Justice – Truth - Courage
At The Federation of The Annunciation Catholic Schools we aim to be a Values Based.
A Value is a principle that guides our thinking and our behaviour.
At our schools, every individual is valued for who they are and what they contribute to the school. Values are intended to support the personal, social and spiritual development of every pupil throughout the school.
The whole staff team, parents and pupils are involved in promoting values and recognising where others are ‘living the values’. The values developed have been selected after consultation with pupils, staff, governors and parents as values which are important within the school community, important throughout life and link to the Dominican values upheld by the Dominican Sisters who founded our school.
Aim of Values Education
Through the Values we aim to:
At our schools, we recognise that during recent years a great deal of national and local effort has been rightly directed towards school improvement and curriculum development.
However we also believe that Values Education has a crucial role in education, because it plays a part in raising achievement and it encourages pupils to be confident, knowledgeable and articulate learners. Values supports quality teaching and learning, whilst making a positive contribution to the development of a fair society equipping our children to become global citizens of the future.
Where you will see our values:
Respect - Tolerance – Commitment – Safety – Excellence – Justice – Truth - Courage

pageCache.pageTitle: The Federation of The Annunciation Catholic Schools - About Us
pageCache.text:
About Us
The History of our Infant School
The school was established in 1931 by the Dominican Sisters to serve the needs of the new parish of Burnt Oak and the existing parishes of Edgware and Kingsbury Green where no Catholic schools existed. We celebrated our eightieth anniversary in 2011 and created a Prayer Garden, in the playground, to mark the occasion.
For almost 60 years the school enjoyed the Sisters' Trusteeship during which period the Sisters, in addition to shouldering the financial burden of the School's upkeep, also supplied the major part of teaching staff. The past and present success of our School is a testament to the hard work and dedication of the Sisters and we continue to maintain strong links with the Dominican community, their ideals and aspirations.
The Junior and Infant Schools were separated in 1975 when the Junior school was relocated to new school premises in The Meads under the new name of St. Martin's Junior School. The Nursery was then added. From September 1995 St. Martin's Junior School has reverted to its original name of The Annunciation Catholic Junior School.
The Archdiocese of Westminster has since 1989 exercised Trusteeship of the school.

pageCache.text:
Mission Statement
‘Be who God meant you to be and you will set the world on fire.’
St. Catherine of Siena
Our mission statement “Be who God meant you to be, and you will set the world on fire” and was created with pupils, parents, staff and governors. We believe it underpins everything we do at our schools. All of the adults and pupils at The Annnunciation Catholic Schools, strive each day, to ensure we are safe, happy and excited to learn with the belief that we can achieve anything. With God’s guidance and blessing, we walk alongside our one another, as we undertake our faith and educational journeys.
Our mission is to recognise the value of each child, to nurture and to develop the God given gifts, talents and spirituality and to foster a secure and happy environment. This will be carried out within the atmosphere of a Catholic community where we travel together on our journey of faith developing our potential.
Prayer, worship and liturgical celebration will take the form of classroom and year group prayer, assemblies, and Masses.
There will be a positive recognition of the individual child, acknowledging the value of achievement in any area of the child’s development.
We aim to create a pleasant, friendly environment in our classrooms, which is conducive to learning
We shall endeavour to identify and meet each child’s needs.
We believe that by working harmoniously together for the good of all, we can create an atmosphere of mutual respect between all members of the school community.
We aim to foster links with the wider community – the children’s families, the parish and link schools. We will make the children aware of the less fortunate members of the community through the work of the Catholic Children’s Society and other agencies

pageCache.pageTitle: The Federation of The Annunciation Catholic Schools - Welcome
pageCache.text:
Welcome
Welcome to The Federation of The Annunciation Catholic Schools
Dear Parents/ Carers,
‘Be who God meant you to be, and you will set the world on fire’
We are a Federation of two schools united by this shared mission, which underpins all that we do at both The Annunciation Catholic Infant School and The Annunciation Catholic Junior School. As a Federation, both schools strive to enrich the academic, cultural and spiritual lives of our pupils, supporting the children in truly flourishing into who God meant them to be.
Founded by Dominican Sisters, since their inception the Schools have been dedicated to nurturing the children and community we serve. As a Federation of Catholic Schools, we recognise our unique responsibility to work in partnership with our families and parish to celebrate and embolden our faith in the community and our young people. Our entire staff and Governors fully understand and embrace this responsibility and are dedicated to carrying on the work and legacy of our founders.
Our schools are deeply committed to nurturing the spiritual growth of our pupils and, working in partnership with you, supporting them on their faith journey towards becoming who God meant them to be. We do this through our celebrations of our faith, be it in our assemblies; our daily worship; or the celebration of Mass either in School or in our Parish Church. Through these events we not only help pupils to understand their faith but empower them to live it and celebrate it in their daily lives. We also help our pupils understand how they live their faith through our focus on the principles of Catholic Social Teaching, which is threaded through our curriculum.
With our Religion at the core of our curriculum, we offer a broad, engaging, challenging and academic programme to enrich the knowledge, skills and understanding of all our pupils. School leaders have designed broad and balanced curriculums, our lesson structures and high quality teaching all enable pupils to know more, remember more and do more.
Reading is given high priority across our curriculum. We believe that reading is a core skill which allows children to access learning across other areas. Our reading offer ensures that children firstly become fluent readers so they can find a love for reading and use it as a tool in life. Your child will encounter reading opportunities across a range of lessons during their school day.
We promote independence and resilience in our pupils as we believe these are life skills they will need if they are to live up to the challenge of our mission statement. Our aim is for our pupils to become life long learners with a passion to find the answer to something they are unsure of. In supporting all children to be who God meant them to be, we never place a glass ceiling on what our pupils can achieve and firmly believe that we offer our children experiences and learning daily that they would not have had were they not to attend school that day.
As a federation, both schools work in close partnership with one another, sharing expertise and resources, thus enabling us to provide the very best education for every pupil in our community.
Please do get in touch if you would like to find out more or if you wish to visit either school. We look forward to welcoming you soon.

Provide both a cumulative and spiral curriculum
